title: The Unbroken Line: First Lesson

texts.details:
You can throw fire. So can a torch. Sit down.

Two things I want from you today, and they are the same lesson. First: conjure me water. Two flasks, made by you, from nothing. Not bought. I shall know.

Second. Some weeks ago an apprentice of mine made a familiar and did not unmake it. It has been drifting in the fields west of the village ever since, growing, and frightening the cattle. We call it the Loose Spark. Go and take it apart, $N.
texts.objectives: Conjure 2 Conjured Water for your teacher and unmake The Loose Spark, which drifts in the fields west of Goldshire. Then return.
texts.progress: Water first. Anyone can destroy. I want to see you make.
texts.completion:
Good water. Cold. And the Spark is gone? Then you have done both halves of what a mage does: you have made a thing from nothing, and you have cleaned up after one.

Remember the second half. Every spell leaves something behind. Mine, yours, those of mages dead three thousand years. The world is full of what we forgot to unmake.

And know this, $N. Someone taught me, and someone taught her, and so back and back, without a break, to the first of us. You are the newest link in that line. I mean you to walk it. Choose one of these. When you have twenty seasons, go to Theocritus, at the Tower of Azora in the east of this forest.

idea: The Unbroken Line, level 10 (Alliance): conjure water and unmake a loose conjuration. Invented: The Loose Spark.
